documents.title: Cloud Service Models
documents.content: Cloud computing is defined as the on-demand delivery of computing resources over the internet. Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) provides virtual machines and networks. Platform as a Service is a cloud service model for deploying applications. Virtualization enables cloud computing at scale. Auto scaling reduces operational costs for variable workloads.

documents.title: A Practical Guide to Serverless
documents.content: AWS Lambda is a serverless compute service. AWS Lambda was developed by Amazon Web Services. Serverless computing is a cloud execution model where the provider manages servers. Kubernetes is used by cloud-native applications for orchestration. Amazon S3 provides object storage for static assets and backups.
